name: Savage Fronds
label: Quest
description: Savage Fronds: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: For every bundle of fronds that you deliver to me, I will pay you with your choice of an insignia of the Dawn or the Crusade.
Insignias may be turned in to the Quartermaster for various rewards.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Your work is vital to the success of our campaign against the Scourge.
